name: Spiny Tachina Fly
desc: Spiny Tachina Fly (Paradejeania rutilioides): eats plants or other primary food sources. Recorded 7 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Paradejeania rutilioides, known generally as the spiny tachina fly or hedgehog fly, is a species of bristle fly in the family Tachinidae.
